name: strato-quantum-platform
description: Strato Quantum Platform - Modern Business Management with AI Agents

scripts.build: npm run install:all && npm run test
scripts.config:validate: cd backend && node -e "require('./src/config').validate(); console.log('✅ Configuration is valid')"
scripts.db:test: cd backend && node -e "require('./src/utils/database').connect().then(() => console.log('✅ Database connection successful')).catch(e => { console.error('❌ Database connection failed:', e.message); process.exit(1); })"
scripts.health:check: curl -f http://localhost:3000/health || echo 'Platform health check failed'
scripts.setup: npm run env:setup && npm run install:all && npm run migrate
scripts.clean: docker system prune -a -f && npm run docker:down

author: Strato Quantum Team
